729: The main protagonist of the manga and anime series YuYu Hakusho.
730: Kuwabara, as most people call him, is the second-toughest kid in Sarayashiki Junior High School and is always trying to usurp Yusuke Urameshi's position as the toughest. In the manga(chp.1) he says he never lost a fight until he met Yusuke.
731: Kurama is first encountered in the series at the same time as Hiei. His ability is in manipulating plants, and he generally wields a whip created from a rose vine, complete with thorns.
732: Hiei is a main character in Yu Yu Hakusho, a demon who prefers to keep his distance from others. Because of this he often comes across as aloof and elusive.
733: Keiko Yukimura is a straight-A student whose personality is opposite that of Yusuke's. Her hobbies include cooking and cleaning. Keiko's parents run a ramen restaurant called the Yukimura Diner.
734: Botan is the guide for the dead across the Sanzu River (the River Styx), Botan is hardly typical of what one would expect from the shinigami, or death god; clad in a bright pink kimono, with her blue hair in a ponytail.
735: She trains Yusuke in the Spirit Light Wave Fist (Reikō Hadō Ken) aka the Spirit Wave in the English dub and coaches him to the extreme. Though she may appears nasty towards Yusuke and the others, she truly cares about all of them, and tries to lead them down the right road.
736: Yukina is the kind, thoughtful, and somewhat naïve twin sister of Hiei. Her name literally means 'Ice Sprout'. Yukina was born as an ice apparition (Kourime, literally ‘Ice Woman’), the same as her clan.
2305: King Enma Jr., usually addressed as Koenma, is the son of Enma, the ruler of the spirit realm, and the one responsible for appointing Yusuke Urameshi as spirit detective.
2371: Toya, Touya in the English anime, is one of the members of the Shadow Channelers in the Dark Tournament. The team's true name, however, was the Shinobi of the Spirit World. It is assumed that Jin and Toya are friends because they are rarely seen not in each other's company.
2957: Jin is one of the members of the Shadow Channelers team during the Dark Tournament. The team's true name, however, was the Shinobi of the Spirit World.
2971: Is the newest of the Three Kings. He is the former second in command to Kurama's brigand prior to Kurama placing his soul into a mortal. Yomi, however, was reckless, losing countless men in unauthorized raids and direct confrontation, thinking it more exciting that way.
2972: A member of the Togoru team in the dark tournament. Karasu is a lower B Class demon. Karasu's personality is largely unknown, with Karasu always remaining calm and serious, never showing his true self. Karasu always wears a mask over his lower face.
3106: Shinobu Sensui was Earth's Spirit Detective before Yusuke Urameshi. According to Koenma, he was the natural choice; he was gifted with amazing spirit awareness, strength, and a strong moral sense of right and wrong. Sensui was very clear-cut and adamant about his moral codes.
3759: Is the cloned son of Yomi. He is created so that Yomi will have a better chance of winning. Despite this, Yomi truly loves him and trains him in earnest.
6892: Shishiwakamaru is a member of the Fractured Fairy Tales in the Dark Tournament. His name is a take on Ushiwakamura, a famous historic general, whose exploits are recounted in Noh theater. The Cape of No Return is based on a Hagoromo, also famous in Noh plays.
7176: Younger Toguro is the younger of the two Toguro brothers, as well as the most powerful member of Team Toguro. He is the main antagonist of the Dark Tournament Saga, aside from Sakyo.
7275: Bui is the least seen and least evil member of Team Toguro.
7803: Rinku is a child-demon who uses yo-yos to attack and is a member of the Jolly Devil Six in the Dark Tournament. Rinku is childish and playful, although this tends to annoy those around him. He is also, apparently, good friends with fellow member Chu.
8570: Suzaku is the final member of the Four Beasts, a phoenix-like demon whose hair acts as antennae. His powers are lightning-based; however, he also uses a flute to control the Makai Bug-infected humans in Human World to do as commanded.
8571: The true captain of the Jolly Devil Six a.k.a. Team Rokuyukai. One of his types of fighting styles is the Drunken Fist. When preforming Drunken Fist he moves with an erratic stumbling motion which, in addition to making him difficult to attack, allows him to move very quickly.
8595: Kazuma Kuwabara's tough older sister. Like her younger brother she also has a high level of Reiki sensitivity and is extremely strong; Shizuru, in the beginning of the manga, has more of a sixth sense than her brother.
8635: Atsuko Urameshi is Yusuke's alcoholic mother, who first gave birth to him when she was only 15 years old. She tries to raise him into a respectable citizen despite her questionable private life.
8641: Kirishima, Okubo, and Sawamura (Komada in the English anime) are Kazuma Kuwabara's lackeys. Okubo's mother, often ill, does not bring enough money into her household, so Okubo holds a job in order to support the household.
8642: Sayaka is the person who was sent by Koenma to do an investigation on Yusuke. If you think about it, Sayaka was the one who sparked Yusuke and Keiko's relationship. The only time she is ever seen is in one episode.
8645: Shiori Minamino is the human mother of Shuichi Minamino (Kurama).
8646: Bat Master, also know as Bat Tamer (Japanese version) or Baldock (English Anime) is a demon in the form of a large bat with a human head and a bowtie. He is in charge of a large number of bats in Genkai's forest and is under Genkai's command.
8647: Kaze-maru is one of the many people who tried to learn Genkai's techniques. He is a VIP bodyguard and one of the last of the ninja. He managed to make it to the Semi-Finals of the fourth test, where he fought Yusuke, and lost.
8648: Kibano is one of the many people who tried to learn Genkai's techniques.
8649: Musashi is one of the many people who tried to learn Genkai's techniques. Musashi fought Kuwabara in the fourth test and lost. Musashi has the ability to mask his spirit emissions so that he can't be seen in the dark by people with high spirit awareness (such as Kuwabara).
8650: Rando is a demon who killed 99 martial arts masters and stole their techniques. He sought to make it a tidy 100 by defeating Genkai, and entered the tournament she devised to determine her successor.

8700: Zeru is the "Captain" Of Jolly Devil Six. His power is based around fire (火炎術), his only attacks he uses are Fire Aura, and a fire blast attack. He seemingly punches Hiei through the stomach, then shoots a fire blast at him, yet again seemingly killing him.
8702: Gonzo Tarukane is a very rich man who kidnaps Yukina. Sakyo ordered Younger Toguro to kill him. In the Filipino dub he is known as "Don Paquito Quito" which is most likely a reference to filipino actor paquito diaz, who is himself famous for playing screen villain roles.
8703: Suzuki, Suzuka in the English version, is a member of the Fractured Fairy Tales. In the past he was known as Tanaka the Powerful Warrior, and one day lost miserably against Younger Toguro.
8704: Seiryu is the third member of the Four Beasts. A dragon demon, he is extremely fast and capable of emitting youki to turn the opponent into ice.
8705: Sakyo is the owner and leader of Team Toguro in the Dark Tournament. He is a very rich man, having gained his wealth from gambling all his life. He is usually a very calm, collected, and intelligent person while keeping his evil side influencing his outside self.
8706: Ruka is a barrier creator and nurse in the Dark Tournament. She was to keep Hiei and the Masked Fighter occupied during the fight between Team Urameshi and the Shadow Channelers.
8708: The dishonorable leader of the Shadow Channelers (Team Masho), he cheats to advance his team in the tournament and isn't above attacking his own teammates if they disagree with him.
8709: Yusuke's spirit beast who hatched from an egg that fed off his actions. Puu is considered to be a reflection of Yusuke's soul, likewise Puu's physical condition reflects Yusuke's, even bieng able to find Yusuke no matter where he is.
8711: Murugu is the annoying bird that Suzaku owns. She is like a spy for Maze Castle, and gives Suzaku information whenever he asks it of her.
8712: Miyuki is one of Tarukane's lackies and one of three powerful demon warriors known as "the Triad". She is a trans woman with a horn on her forehead and a red quipao.
8714: Byakko is the second of the Four Beasts, a large tiger demon who can absorb reiki into his body to make himself stronger.
8716: Elder Toguro is the oldest of the Toguro Brothers. He is very tiny, and usually rides on Younger Toguro's shoulder instead of walking. He is much more unpleasant than his younger brother, and can manage to anger the usually calm Younger Toguro.
8717: Juri is the referee of the Dark Tournament after Koto was forced to switch to commentary. She is apparently a sea-creature demon. She is an idol in the human and demon planes.
8720: George Saotome is an oni working with Koenma as his personal assistant whenever Botan is on Earth. Koenma sometimes clashes with him and primarily vents his anger on him if he is anxious over a situation.
8722: Gama is a member of the Shadow Channelers (Team Masho) whose speciality is the "secret art" of make-up, using paint made of blood to bring out spiritual abilities and increase strength.
8728: Koto is the referee in the Dark Tournament. She is a fox demon like Kurama, but seems to have no special abilities. She is later replaced by Juri and switches to commentary. She was also the referee in the Makai Tournament. She is an idol in both the human and demon planes.
8729: Kuro Momotaro a.k.a. Dark Peach Boy or Poison Peach Boy (English manga) uses one of the first of many strange items from the Fractured Fairy Tales, enchanted Millet Dumplings.
13837: The strongest of the Three Kings, the God of War, and the strongest character in the series. Raizen, however, was injured in battle and nursed back to life by a human who he fell in love with and impregnated with his baby.
16762: Mukuro is one of the Three Kings of Makai. She's been a sex slave since birth and on her 7th birthday she decided to pour acid on her body to have her master abandon her.
18772: He uses his medical knowledge to heal and manipulate his own body and create demon parasites that spread a psychic disease. While he thinks of humans diseased at first, he eventually atones by using his abilities to heal people
20961: Shigure the Osteopath is a demon surgeon who implants Hiei with his Jagan eye. Shigure charges his customers with weird requests, such as an "interesting story" or a promise, rather than money.
24627: Hagiri Kaname, more commonly known as Sniper, was a member of Sensui's Seven. He is able to extend his Territory, which gives him the ability to send any objects fly towards an opponent at high speeds by psionically making visible target signs appear on the opponent.
26765: Kido knows a lot about Yusuke thanks to Master Genkai. Kido went to Master Genkai's with Kaitou and Yana when his powers awoke. His powers are controlling other people's shadow, if he stands on it you'll be paralyzed.
28803: Itsuki is Sensui's right hand man in carrying out Sensui's evil plan. Although he has strong psychic abilities, he needs another ability which can tear dimensions. That's where Kuwabara's part comes in. As he is the only one in Ningenki who can do something like that.
28999: Tsukihito Amanuma, also known as Gamemaster, is a human who develops superhuman powers as a result of the demon plane hole opened by Sensui. Amanuma is able to bring video games to life, creating his territory within them.
29030: A human who develops superhuman powers as a result of the demon plane hole opened by Sensui. He is able to mix his blood with water to create water golems. His territory is contained within these monsters. Mitarai is emotionally scarred after watching the Black Chapter.
29032: Yu Kaito is a human who develops superhuman powers as a result of the demon plane hole opened by Sensui. He is a student at Meioh Private Academy where he constantly attempts to outdo Kurama for top grades.
29033: Mitsunari Yanagisawa is a human who develops superhuman powers as a result of the demon plane hole opened by Sensui. His power is "Copy" which allows him to copy the appearance, memories, attributes, abilities, and spirit print of anyone he touches.
34455: Another deliverer of the dead like Botan, Ayame's chief purpose in the Spirit World seems to be doing research for Koenma.
38021: Hina is the mother of Hiei and Yukina. Sometime in her life, she left the Glacial Village, where her kind live, and conceived children with a male. This resulted in the birth of twins, Hiei and Yukina.
39248: One of Raizen's old friends, Enki is slightly slow-witted but amazingly powerful.
39249: One of Raizen's Generals. His spirit class is in the S level and he has the ability to convert his body into a puddy-like substance, making it extremely difficult to attack or even hurt him.
39252: Enki's wife, Koko was also an old friend of Raizen's, and would have much rather married him instead. She seems to love drinking and complaining endlessly.
39254: Sato Kuroko, previously Sanada Kuroko, is the first spirit detective. She retired, as she said, to "pursue love". Kuroko married a writer, Shogo, and has 2 children.
39256: Kuroko's nine-year old son. Both children prefer their mother's original surname and address each other as such, however their true surname is Sato.
39257: Kuroko's eight-year old daughter. Both children prefer their mother's original surname and address each other as such, however their true surname is Sato.
39258: An old friend of Raizen's, Natsume and her brother enter the Makai Tournament.
39259: An ice apparition, Rui was a close friend of Hina.
39265: She was an unnamed female ancestor of Yusuke's who Raizen fell in love with. She died shortly after giving birth to his child.
